reason: I can find used 17s on Marketplace and eBay for £150-220 a set and haggle that down, so £280 from a seller I've never heard of feels like new-ish money. The check-in-person and refund bits are good, but I'd still shop around first.
objection: Will they actually fit my car, and why pay £280 when I can pick up a decent set for under £200 and knock the price down?
would_change_my_mind: Around £200-220 a set for my exact fitment, with tyres thrown in or a few reviews from locals.
